candidates.rationale: The model is conflating command allowlisting with sandbox enforcement (path traversal/symlink checks) and rambles until hitting the token limit. By explicitly stating that arguments and environment details are irrelevant to the allowlist check and enforcing a strict output format, we address both the logical confusion and the format failure.
candidates.what: Rewrite the system prompt to explicitly define the policy as checking ONLY the command name against the allowlist, ignoring all arguments and environment details, and mandate a strict single-word output format to prevent token exhaustion.
